'''2014 Alderaan Regionals''' was a Players Committee constructed regional, 28 June 2014, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref> Published lists are the 20-page PDF on the Players Committee decklist desk. Xerox sheets from the same event are listed below as those scans are transcribed. The PDF does not name a champion.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 28 June 2014
* '''Winner:''' —
